description: Hadith notes removed from frontend/src/data/quranicNames.ts (QuranicNamesPage). They were free text with collection numbers and no verified source. A scholar must verify text, collection, number and grader (only when a grader is named) before any entry returns, as a structured SupportingNote (kind=hadith). Not rendered anywhere.

entries.issue: Was shown as a hadith ('Sahih Bukhari 3350') but the quoted words are Qur'an 4:125. Do not restore; quote 4:125 through quranExcerpt if needed.
